equipment.name: Material Hoist
equipment.short: Heavy-duty vertical transport for materials on construction sites.
equipment.subtitle: High-Capacity Material/Builder Hoist
equipment.desc: Our Builder Hoists are robust, safety-certified machines ideal for high-rise and multi-storey construction. They transport heavy materials — bricks, sand, steel — vertically with ease, reducing manual labour and saving time. Available in single-cage and twin-cage configurations.

equipment.name: Suspended Platform (Gondola)
equipment.short: Rope-suspended work platform for exterior building maintenance and finishing.
equipment.subtitle: Motorised Gondola / ZLP Platform
equipment.desc: Suspended platforms (gondolas) are used for external building maintenance, glass cleaning, painting and plastering on finished high-rise structures. Our ZLP series gondolas are electrically powered with built-in safety locks and are CE-compliant.

equipment.name: RMC Plant
equipment.short: Portable and stationary concrete mixers for on-site concrete preparation.
equipment.subtitle: Tilting Drum Concrete Mixer
equipment.desc: Reliable concrete mixers for all construction needs. Our mixers are built for heavy-duty use on site, ensuring consistent quality concrete. Available in electric and diesel variants.

equipment.name: Bar Bending Machine
equipment.short: Electrically operated machine to bend TMT steel bars up to 40 mm.
equipment.subtitle: Electric Bar Bending Machine
equipment.desc: Bar bending machines are essential for any RCC structure. Our machines handle TMT bars from 6 mm to 40 mm with precision angle settings. They are built for heavy-duty continuous use on large construction sites and are available for both sale and rent.

equipment.name: Bar Cutting Machine
equipment.short: Heavy-duty machine for cutting TMT reinforcement bars accurately on site.
equipment.subtitle: Electric Bar Cutting Machine
equipment.desc: Our bar cutting machines provide clean, accurate cuts on TMT reinforcement bars in seconds. With a robust cast-iron body and high-torque motor, they handle bars up to 40 mm diameter. Portable models also available for smaller sites.

equipment.name: Concrete Pump
equipment.short: Stationary and trailer-mounted pumps for placing concrete at height or distance.
equipment.subtitle: Stationary / Trailer Concrete Pump
equipment.desc: Concrete pumps dramatically speed up concrete placement, especially in high-rise construction or areas inaccessible to trucks. Our pumps deliver concrete vertically and horizontally with minimal segregation. Available as stationary and trailer-mounted units.

equipment.name: Concrete Batching Plant
equipment.short: Fully automated batching plants for large-scale RMC production on site.
equipment.subtitle: Stationary Concrete Batching Plant
equipment.desc: For large infrastructure and residential projects requiring consistent, high-volume concrete supply, our batching plants offer complete automation with computerised mix control. Capacities available from 15 m³/hr to 90 m³/hr. Installation and commissioning support included.

reviews.name: Anil Kumar

reviews.name: Rajesh Verma
reviews.text: Good range of equipment. Rented a concrete pump for our high-rise project. Smooth coordination and on-time delivery to site.

reviews.name: Venkat Rao
reviews.text: Been buying from Jayalaxmi for years. Very trustworthy. If there is ever a breakdown, they send a technician the same day.

reviews.name: Mohammad Farhan
reviews.text: The gondola platforms they supplied are excellent quality. Workers feel safe and the support from the team is outstanding.

reviews.name: Prasad Nair
reviews.text: Prompt delivery, good condition equipment. Would have given 5 stars but one mixer needed minor adjustment on first day. Otherwise no issues.

reviews.name: Srinivas Rao
reviews.text: Very professional. They explained everything about the mast climbing platform and gave us training too. Highly recommended.

reviews.name: Kiran Babu
reviews.text: Competitive pricing compared to other vendors in Hyderabad. Equipment is always in good maintained condition. Great after-sales too.
